pay_national_board_017.answer: $5,000/year differential for NBPTS; $2,000/year for other national certification; up to $300 NBPTS fee reimbursement; $1,000 lump sum for other national cert.
pay_national_board_017.evidence: A unit member who has successfully completed and attained NBPTS certification shall receive: A. A differential of $5,000 per year for each year they maintain their NBPTS certification. ... B. The Board of Education shall reimburse an employee for up to one (1) retake of the NBPTS application fee ($300). Unit members who have attained other national certification in their discipline where NBPTS certification does not apply shall receive a one-time lump sum payment of $1,000. The unit member shall also receive a differential of $2,000 per year for each year the other applicable national certification remains in good standing.
